_meta.description: NuvoVet procedure codebook (NVP). Internal codes designed to map 1:1 onto MAFRA '동물 진료의 권장 표준' procedure names (4,930 coded, 2025-04 revision) once the official code table is ingested; 'mafra_standard_ref' is reserved for that mapping.
_meta.benchmark_note: Prices are KRW per unit. Except where a public source is cited, distributions are seed estimates for development and demos only and must be replaced with MAFRA survey data and partner claims history before any production decision. Codes with benchmark null have no public price source yet; the pricing rule must skip them (no invented prices).

emr_categories._note: EMR line names follow '<category>-<item>(<modifier>)' (EMR_Field_Analysis.md). The prefix is a hint: codes in these categories win near-ties, prefix_synonyms only count under their prefix, and an unmatched item falls back to 'default'. 'aliases' also accepts printed receipt headings passed as category_raw.

_meta.matching: Terms are compacted (lowercase, no spaces/punctuation). Latin terms of 4 characters or fewer match only whole Latin tokens of the line (a digit suffix is allowed: 'chem' matches 'Chem10'). Longest term wins; within 2 characters of the longest, codes agreeing with the EMR category hint win, then longer terms, then non-generic codes. A hit on a code listed in another hit's 'supersedes' yields to that code (ICU over general ward, pyometra surgery over spay).
changelog: 2026.10.1: +60 codes, +73 synonyms on existing codes (+2 prefix-gated) from the 2026-10-02 EMR-probe audit and held-out review (departures from the audit proposal in docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md); coverage_category, prefix_synonyms, supersedes, emr_categories, generic_codes; new codes carry benchmark null.
